# proof_of_Build

> Execution-based startup talent platform. Founders post real challenges, builders ship working prototypes, and hiring happens through escrow-backed contracts.

proof_of_Build is a marketplace where startups hire engineers, designers, and operators based on working demos rather than résumés. Builders submit prototypes for posted challenges; founders review side-by-side, pay through escrow, and convert top performers into 3, 6, or 12-month engagements.

## Pages

- [Home](/): What proof_of_Build is and how the hire-via-build loop works.
- [Browse projects](/browse): Live challenges open for builder submissions.

## Optional
